title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

faults.what: The supplied audio transcript reports speech, “Zamanla geçer.”, despite the explicit no-voice requirement.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical ad delivers the requested candle, warm look and exact text, but unwanted speech makes an audio revision necessary.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 is reported as 15 seconds, and its sampled frames have a vertical 9:16 format.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: All four frames show an unlabeled clear cylindrical glass jar containing ivory-colored wax and one lit wick.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar, wax fill, single wick and thick clear base remain visually consistent across the sampled views.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm amber lighting and calm product framing are visible, and framing varies across samples, but still frames cannot establish whether camera movement is gentle.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The exact opening phrase is visible at 1.9 seconds and the exact closing phrase at 13.2 seconds.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The transcript explicitly reports speech, “Zamanla geçer.”; the presence and character of piano cannot be verified from the supplied audio information.
